title: Trolley · lever and tracks
source: A runaway trolley is heading toward five workers on the main track. Maria can pull a lever that switches the trolley onto a side track, where one worker stands. If she pulls the lever, the trolley will kill that worker and spare the five. If she does not, it will kill the five and spare the one. Maria cannot stop the trolley. Should she pull the lever?
